别名

あらすじ

It was graduation season.

Yuuya, toughened by his permanent unpopular status, was tired of his own thoughts.

Momoka was a fluffy, kind of ditzy friend that never became more, and now she was going to college.

They would drift apart… having never been together.

  • 日本語名: 進化実況 —パンドラの箱—
  • 英語名: Shinka Jikkyou -Pandora no Hako-

别名

  • Reality -Pandoras Box-

あらすじ

Kouichi Itoda.

He was an introverted type.

In spite of this he had a girlfriend from

the same class, who was beautiful, kind,

and rather out of his league.

Kouichi worried about this a lot.

One day an incident happened near the school.

A package arrived from one of her male friends.
